import sys, json, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as impl

# new numeric edge cases
tests = [
  (b'{"services":[' + b'1'*5000 + b'],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', 'E_SCHEMA', 'huge int in services'),
  (b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[],"x":1e400}', 'E_SCHEMA', 'overflow float extra key'),
  (b'{"services":[1e400],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', 'E_SCHEMA', 'overflow float in services'),
  (b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[],"x":1' + b'0'*100 + b'}', 'E_SCHEMA', 'big int extra key'),
  (b'{"services":[],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"true"}}],"queries":[],"z":NaN}', 'E_JSON', 'NaN literal'),
  (b'{"services":[],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"true"}}],"queries":[],"z":Infinity}', 'E_JSON', 'Infinity literal'),
  (b'{"services":[],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"true"}}],"queries":[],"z":-Infinity}', 'E_JSON', '-Infinity literal'),
  (b'{"services":[],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match","path":[]}}],"queries":[[]]}', 'OK', 'empty alphabet match empty'),
  (b'{"services":[],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"startswith","path":[]}}],"queries":[[]]}', 'OK', 'empty alphabet startswith empty'),
  (b'{"services":[],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"contains","path":[]}}],"queries":[[]]}', 'OK', 'empty alphabet contains empty'),
  (b'{"services":[],"rules":[{"action":"drop","when":{"op":"endswith","path":[]}}],"queries":[[]]}', 'OK', 'empty alphabet drop endswith empty'),
  (b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match","path":["a"]}},{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match","path":[]}}],"queries":[[],["a"],["a","a"]]}', 'OK', 'match empty plus match a'),
  (b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"not","arg":{"op":"match","path":[]}}}],'
   b'"queries":[[],["a"],["a","a"]]}', 'OK', 'not match empty => all nonempty paths'),
  (b'{"services":["a","a\\u0000b","\\ud83d\\ude00","e\\u0301","\\u00e9"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"startswith","path":["\\ud83d\\ude00"]}}],"queries":[[],["\\ud83d\\ude00"],["\\ud83d\\ude00","e\\u0301"]]}', 'OK', 'weird names'),
]
for raw, expect, note in tests:
    got = impl.process(raw)
    if expect == 'OK':
        okk = got.startswith('{"ok":true')
    else:
        okk = ('"error":"%s"' % expect) in got
    print(('PASS' if okk else 'FAIL'), note, '->', got[:150] if not okk else got[:90])

# timing: 1MiB line of digits inside services
line = b'{"services":[' + b'1'*1048000 + b'],"rules":[],"queries":[]}'
print('line len', len(line))
t0=time.time(); r = impl.process(line); print('huge digits ->', r, '%.3fs' % (time.time()-t0))
# 1 MiB of a long service string (valid, 64 scalars max though) -> limit
# timing: line at exact byte limit with valid json
big_q = b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[' + b'["a"],'*104850 + b'[]]}'
print('len', len(big_q))
t0=time.time(); r = impl.process(big_q); print('big queries ->', r, '%.3fs' % (time.time()-t0))
EOF
